issue.title: Review typing-tip adoption after three weeks and apply the stop rule
issue.description: After bob-cli-j9 has shipped and roughly three weeks of actual use have elapsed, read the local AliasTipLedger weeks counts, group by tipped lesson, and compare hits/(hits+misses) over the observation window, including shown counts and sparse data limitations. Confirm the deployed version contains the landing repairs to hit withdrawal. Keep lessons if alias share rose; otherwise propose their removal per the approved stop rule. Stop immediately on a confirmed false tip or input regression. If three weeks of comparable data are not yet available, document the missing window and defer; do not treat missing data as success or failure. Coordinate any actual feature removal through the normal plan workflow. Reference plan:202611/capture_alias_typing_tips.md and the proposing bead bob-cli-j9.4.

task_type_fields.proposal: Evaluate the shipped typing-tip lessons from three weeks of local weekly adoption counts and apply the approved keep/delete/false-tip stop rule.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The implementation epic can create the ledger and land the UI, but the required three-week observation period begins only after shipping.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-j9.4 note #1 requires a post-shipping review using weekly ledger data; that future observation cannot be completed during implementation landing.
